1	/**
2	 * Default one-shot summarization and durable checkpoint framing.
3	 *
4	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic/summarizer
5	 */
6	
7	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
8	import { contentHasImage, createUserMessage, BlockAssembler, LlmError } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
9	import type {
10	  ContentBlock, FinishReason, GenerateOptions, Message, TokenUsage, ToolSchema,
11	} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
12	import type { Agent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent'
13	
14	interface SummaryConfig {
15	  readonly summarizationProvider: string
16	  readonly summarizationModel: string
17	  readonly maxTokens: number
18	}
19	
20	/** Tags wrapping the structured summary inside the landed checkpoint node. */
21	const SUMMARY_OPEN_TAG = '<compacted-summary>'
22	const SUMMARY_CLOSE_TAG = '</compacted-summary>'
23	
24	/**
25	 * The summarization directive, delivered as the FINAL user message after the
26	 * replayed conversation rather than as a distinct summarizer system prompt.
27	 * Keeping the conversation's own system prompt, tools, and message prefix in
28	 * front of it makes the auxiliary call a genuine prefix of the last routed
29	 * request, so the provider's KV cache is reused instead of invalidated.
30	 */
31	const COMPACTION_INSTRUCTION = [
32	  'You are now acting as a compaction engine for this AI coding assistant. Condense the conversation ABOVE into a structured checkpoint that lets another model resume the work with no loss of essential context.',
33	  '',
34	  'Output EXACTLY the Markdown structure below: keep every section, in order. Use terse bullets, not prose paragraphs. Write "(none)" for an empty section — never drop a section.',
35	  '',
36	  '## Primary Request and Intent',
37	  "- [the user's original and evolving goals; quote verbatim where the exact wording matters]",
38	  '',
39	  '## Key Technical Concepts',
40	  '- [technologies, frameworks, patterns, and conventions in play]',
41	  '',
42	  '## Files and Code',
43	  '- [exact path: why it matters, key changes or snippets]',
44	  '',
45	  '## Errors and Fixes',
46	  '- [error: how it was resolved, plus any related user feedback]',
47	  '',
48	  '## Pending Jobs',
49	  '- [explicitly requested work not yet completed]',
50	  '',
51	  '## Current Work',
52	  '- [precisely what was in progress at this checkpoint]',
53	  '',
54	  '## Next Step',
55	  '- [the single next action, directly in line with the most recent request, or "(none)"]',
56	  '',
57	  '## Critical Context',
58	  '- [decisions and their rationale, constraints, user preferences, open questions, data needed to continue]',
59	  '',
60	  'Rules:',
61	  '- Write concise English engineering prose. Preserve exact file paths, commands, error strings, identifiers, numeric values, function signatures, and syntax fragments.',
62	  '- Capture user feedback and explicit instructions faithfully, especially corrections.',
63	  '- Do NOT mention this summarization request or that the context was compacted.',
64	  '- Output only the checkpoint text: do not call any tool or take any other action.',
65	  `- If the conversation already contains a ${SUMMARY_OPEN_TAG} block, it is a PRIOR checkpoint. Do not copy it forward verbatim: preserve still-true facts, drop stale ones, and merge newer information into a single consolidated summary under the same structure.`,
66	].join('\n')
67	
68	/** Framing that makes the replacement user message established context. */
69	const CHECKPOINT_PREAMBLE =
70	  'This is an automatically generated checkpoint condensing an earlier span of the conversation to free up context. Treat the captured context as established background and build on it without restating it. Continue the task directly from the messages that follow, without acknowledging this checkpoint.'
71	
72	/**
73	 * The replayed conversation surface the summarizer condenses. Reproducing the
74	 * last routed request's system prompt, tools, and leading messages verbatim
75	 * lets the auxiliary call reuse the provider's warm prefix cache; the trailing
76	 * compaction instruction is then the only novel input.
77	 */
78	export interface SummarizationInput {
79	  /** The conversation's own system prompt, reused for prefix-cache alignment; absent for a system-less request. */
80	  readonly system?: string
81	  /** The conversation's tool schemas, reused for prefix-cache alignment; absent when the request carried none. */
82	  readonly tools?: readonly ToolSchema[]
83	  /** The shadowed region, in surface order, that precedes the compaction instruction. */
84	  readonly messages: readonly Message[]
85	}
86	
87	/** Safe summary content plus the exact auxiliary call envelope recorded with it. */
88	export type SummaryResult = {
89	  summary: ContentBlock[]
90	  provider: string
91	  model: string
92	  maxTokens?: number
93	  /** Provider-reported usage for this summarization request. */
94	  usage?: TokenUsage
95	} & (
96	  | {
97	    /** Complete provider output before the text-only summary projection. */
98	    rawOutput: ContentBlock[]
99	    /** Identifies exactly one call through this context's `ctx.llm.stream()`. */
100	    llmStreamCall: true
101	  }
102	  | {
103	    /** Optional complete output from an unmarked template, remote, or other summarizer. */
104	    rawOutput?: ContentBlock[]
105	    /** An unmarked result does not identify a call through this context's LLM seam. */
106	    llmStreamCall?: never
107	  }
108	)
109	
110	/**
111	 * Run the default cache-reusing `ctx.llm.stream()` summarization call: replay
112	 * the conversation prefix, then append the compaction instruction as the final
113	 * user message so the provider's warm prefix cache is reused.
114	 * @param ctx - context providing the LLM service.
115	 * @param config - resolved backend configuration.
116	 * @param input - replayed conversation prefix (system, tools, and leading messages) to condense.
117	 * @param agent - supplies routed-model history, fallback model, and session id.
118	 * @param signal - optional cancellation forwarded to the adapter.
119	 * @returns safe text-only summary blocks and the exact call envelope and output.
120	 */
121	export async function summarizeWithLlm(
122	  ctx: Context,
123	  config: SummaryConfig,
124	  input: SummarizationInput,
125	  agent: Agent,
126	  signal?: AbortSignal,
127	): Promise<SummaryResult> {
128	  const latest = agent.session.requestHeader()?.config
129	  const configured = config.summarizationProvider.length === 0
130	    ? undefined
131	    : { provider: config.summarizationProvider, model: config.summarizationModel }
132	  const agentTarget = agent.options.provider !== undefined
133	    && agent.options.provider.length > 0
134	    && agent.options.model !== undefined
135	    && agent.options.model.length > 0
136	    ? { provider: agent.options.provider, model: agent.options.model }
137	    : undefined
138	  const target = configured ?? latest ?? agentTarget
139	  if (target === undefined) {
140	    throw new Error(
141	      'no provider/model available for summarization: set both BasicCompactionConfig summarization fields, route one request, or set both AgentOptions fields',
142	    )
143	  }
144	
145	  const assembler = new BlockAssembler()
146	  const messages: Message[] = [
147	    ...input.messages,
148	    createUserMessage({
149	      content: [{ type: 'text', text: COMPACTION_INSTRUCTION }],
150	      source: { kind: 'plugin', plugin: 'dsh-compaction-basic' },
151	    }),
152	  ]
153	  const options: GenerateOptions = {
154	    provider: target.provider,
155	    model: target.model,
156	    messages,
157	    ...input.system === undefined ? {} : { system: input.system },
158	    ...input.tools === undefined ? {} : { tools: [...input.tools] },
159	    maxTokens: config.maxTokens,
160	    sessionId: agent.session.id,
161	    purpose: 'compaction',
162	    ...signal === undefined ? {} : { signal },
163	  }
164	  for await (const chunk of ctx.llm.stream(options)) assembler.push(chunk)
165	  const error = finishError(assembler.finish)
166	  if (error !== undefined) throw error
167	
168	  const rawOutput = assembler.blocks()
169	  const summary = summaryText(rawOutput)
170	  if (!summary.some(block => block.text.trim().length > 0)) {
171	    throw new Error('summarization produced no text summary content')
172	  }
173	  return {
174	    summary,
175	    rawOutput,
176	    llmStreamCall: true,
177	    provider: options.provider,
178	    model: options.model,
179	    maxTokens: config.maxTokens,
180	    ...(assembler.usage === undefined ? {} : { usage: assembler.usage }),
181	  }
182	}
183	
184	/**
185	 * Wrap raw summary blocks in the durable checkpoint framing.
186	 * @param summary - safe text-only model output.
187	 * @returns content for the synthesized replacement user message.
188	 */
189	export function frameSummary(summary: readonly ContentBlock[]): ContentBlock[] {
190	  return [
191	    { type: 'text', text: `${CHECKPOINT_PREAMBLE}\n\n${SUMMARY_OPEN_TAG}` },
192	    ...summary,
193	    { type: 'text', text: SUMMARY_CLOSE_TAG },
194	  ]
195	}
196	
197	/** Map a terminal summarization finish to its fail-closed error. */
198	function finishError(finish: FinishReason): Error | undefined {
199	  switch (finish.kind) {
200	    case 'error':
201	    case 'aborted': {
202	      const error = new Error(finish.failure.message) as Error & { code?: string }
203	      error.code = finish.failure.code
204	      return error
205	    }
206	    case 'max-tokens': {
207	      const error = new Error('summarization truncated at the token cap (incomplete checkpoint)') as Error & { code?: string }
208	      error.code = 'MAX_TOKENS'
209	      return error
210	    }
211	    default:
212	      return undefined
213	  }
214	}
215	
216	/** Reject visual output and keep only text before synthesizing a user message. */
217	function summaryText(
218	  blocks: readonly ContentBlock[],
219	): Array<Extract<ContentBlock, { type: 'text' }>> {
220	  if (contentHasImage(blocks)) {
221	    throw new LlmError('compaction summary cannot contain image output', 'UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT')
222	  }
223	  return blocks.filter((block): block is Extract<ContentBlock, { type: 'text' }> => block.type === 'text')
224	}
